children.default: A few notes on how we build, ship, and stay out of your way.

default.slide_body:
Plain talk, no runaround

You get a real person who writes the code, not a layer of account managers. Questions get answered the same day, and you always know where the work stands.

Ship in weeks, not quarters

We scope tight, build in the open, and hand you something working early. Small releases mean fewer surprises and faster feedback from the people who actually use it.

Security baked in from day one

Audits, hardening, and sane defaults come standard. We catch the real risks before they turn into incidents, so launch day stays boring in the best way.
